discoveredFixes: Admin Visual Engine and Business tabs were rendered but absent from VALID_ADMIN_SECTIONS.

Spelling remote command responses reloaded repositories and then lost the live summary read model through rehydrate sanitisation; applyCommandResponse now reapplies the Worker subjectReadModel after reload.
